result.summary: The page layout is mostly coherent, but two clear rendering defects stand out: the second 'Popular right now' card is missing its restaurant name/rating/meta row entirely, and a stray black bar in the bottom navigation overlaps the middle tab icons. There are also smaller styling inconsistencies in card treatments.

issues.description: The second card in 'Popular right now' (the pizza card with the -20% badge) shows only an image — the restaurant name, rating, delivery time/fee and cuisine metadata row that the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has is absent, leaving blank space below the image.
issues.suggestion: Render the same title/rating/meta block for every card in the list, and add a fallback/skeleton if the data is still loading.

issues.description: In the bottom tab bar a thick black horizontal bar is drawn across the middle, overlapping and partially obscuring the search and bookmark/saved icons, so those tabs look broken and unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Remove or reposition the stray bar (likely a mis-sized gesture/indicator element or an active-tab indicator) so it sits below the icons and does not overlap them.

issues.description: The favourite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently between the two 'Popular right now' cards: the first has a white circular background with a dark outline heart, the second has a dark circular background with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent favourite-button style (same background, icon colour and size) across all cards.

issues.description: The first 'Fastest near you' thumbnail (Green Bowl Poké) uses a light grey background while the sibling thumbnails use dark photographic backgrounds, making the row look uneven.
issues.suggestion: Normalise image treatment (consistent background/aspect ratio or an overlay) so thumbnails in the carousel match visually.

issues.description: Bottom navigation icons have no text labels, making their purpose ambiguous, and there is no visible active-state indication for the current tab.
issues.suggestion: Add short text labels or accessible names to each tab and clearly highlight the active tab.
